title: Planner-id aliases (skill_catalog/aliases_{mag,wag}.json)
description: Version 0.1.0 (2026-10-18). Resolves every routine-planner id to its catalog element(s). Aliases never change once published; a merged element forwards to its replacement through `merged`.

aliases.description: Planner id -> element ids (several when one printed record covers several elements).

merged.description: Retired element id -> the element that replaced it.
